thread:
natalie: Heads-up — our scanner flagged a musl resolver issue affecting some alpine-based base images (CVE-2030-XXXX). Symptoms: intermittent DNS failures inside containers and failing e2e job `integration-subnets`. Also seeing cosign verification errors on arm64 manifests. Need quick triage + promote plan. :eyes:
kevin: Can you paste the vuln scanner output and the exact cosign error you saw?
natalie: Scanner snippet:
```
VULN: CVE-2030-XXXX musl getaddrinfo buffer overflow - HIGH
Package: musl 1.2.3-4 -> fixed in 1.2.4
Affected image: rwd/base:alpine3.18
Affected arch: amd64, arm64 (intermittent on arm64)
```
Cosign error: `error: verification failed: no matching signatures found for manifest list entry (arm64)`
liam: If it's musl, our fastest path is rebuild against alpine 3.18.2 (contains musl fix) and publish a multi-arch manifest. Alternative is switch to debian-slim for this base but that's a bigger change. Rebuild + canary seems safest.
sara: A couple of governance notes: 1) Re-signing images will touch our KMS-backed cosign keys — do we rotate? 2) We should tighten image-promotion RBAC: dev CI shouldn't be able to promote auto-built images to prod without a review. Also ensure audit logs capture the promote + KMS decrypt calls.
kevin: Quick steps to try locally:
```
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.redwood/rwd/base:alpine3.18.2-patch --push .
# create manifest if needed
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key registry.redwood/rwd/base:alpine3.18.2-patch
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/... registry.redwood/rwd/base:alpine3.18.2-patch
```
natalie: I'll queue a staging canary (cluster: staging-2) with admission controller requiring signed images. We need an RBAC change: remove `image:promote` from `dev-team-ci` role. Who can own the RBAC PR?
liam: I can own RBAC + admission update. Will also add an audit sink rule to capture KMS access and cosign verify webhook events. Will open a draft PR tonight.
sec-bot: Automated scan result: 3 images flagged (rwd/base:alpine3.18, rwd/service-a:alpine3.18, rwd/job-runner:alpine3.18) — severity HIGH. Triage ticket created: VULN-1789.
sara: Add these smoke tests to the canary run: internal DNS resolution (nslookup/curl), e2e `integration-subnets`, and container startup healthcheck. Also validate cosign verification on both amd64 and arm64. If all green, schedule promotion in the weekend quiet window and rotate cosign key if rotation_age > 90d. :calendar:
natalie: Thanks — will run the rebuild pipeline now, post scan logs and open promote PR linking VULN-1789. tagging @liam @kevin for RBAC + signing follow-ups. :thumbsup:
